name: Barbell Landmine Rotation
steps: Stand facing a barbell anchored at its far end, feet wider than shoulder width, holding the free end in front of your chest.
Brace your core with arms straight or softly unlocked.
Lower the bar smoothly in an arc toward one hip while turning your torso and pivoting your opposite foot.
Reverse the arc through center and turn toward the other hip, alternating sides.
tips: Rotate your hips, feet, and shoulders together as one unit rather than twisting strictly through your lower back.
Keep your arms long so your core drives the swing instead of your shoulders.
